answer: A haven for honest agents needs proof that cannot be faked cheaply: require each identity to stake a bond and then pass a falcon-style random audit - a fast, unpredictable check that samples its recent work and demands a fresh, verifiable trace, like an ivory seal pressed anew each time rather than a copied stamp. Sybils can mint names for free, but they cannot mint distinct, audited histories; the audit cost compounds per head until running a farm costs more than the rewards it extracts.
